<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
 I've got enough context now to move forward. I'll add a new prompt to the chezmoi config for installing IAC tools, then create an ansible role to handle the actual installation with the necessary tasks.

I need to register this role in both the macOS and Linux playbooks with the `iac_tools` tag, update the ansible runner script to include the role hash and conditionally apply the tag, and modify the Dockerfile to accept the install flag. I'll also need to update the documentation—adding the new tag to CLAUDE.md, creating a dedicated tools guide, and updating the README's tools section.

For the actual installations, I'm planning to use Homebrew on macOS for Azure CLI, and on Linux I'll use the official Microsoft installation script with sudo, falling back to pip for non-root environments.

Terraform will use Homebrew on macOS and HashiCorp's apt repository on Linux (with sudo), while non-root installs can grab the precompiled binaries directly. OpenTofu follows a similar pattern with Homebrew on macOS and their deb repository or standalone installer on Linux, with GitHub releases as the non-root fallback.

Since both Terraform and OpenTofu are just single static binaries, this is pretty lightweight overall. I'm thinking one unified `installIacTools` prompt makes sense rather than separate toggles for each tool, and I'll include all three since the user indicated they're not heavy and didn't exclude any of them.

Let me check the README to see if there's a tools list that needs updating.</details></think>

```json
  "plan": "## Scope\n\nInstall three Infrastructure-as-Code CLIs behind a single &#96;installIacTools&#96; chezmoi prompt (default &#96;false&#96;):\n\n- **Azure CLI** (&#96;az&#96;) — per [Microsoft's install doc](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cli/azure/install-azure-cli)\n- **Terraform** (&#96;terraform&#96;) — HashiCorp\n- **OpenTofu** (&#96;tofu&#96;) — Linux Foundation fork\n\nTerraform and OpenTofu coexist (different binary names), so installing both is zero-conflict. All three are lightweight CLIs (Terraform/OpenTofu are single static Go binaries; Azure CLI is a Python bundle but ships as an OS package).\n\n## Install matrix\n\n- macOS (Homebrew, always): &#96;brew install azure-cli terraform opentofu&#96; — Terraform requires the &#96;hashicorp/tap&#96;; OpenTofu is a first-class formula (&#96;tofu&#96;). Pattern mirrors the speedtest tap handling in [dot_ansible/roles/networking_tools/tasks/main.yml](dot_ansible/roles/networking_tools/tasks/main.yml) lines 25–40.\n- Linux with sudo (Debian/Ubuntu):\n  - Azure CLI: Microsoft apt repo (keyring + source list + &#96;apt install azure-cli&#96;).\n  - Terraform: HashiCorp apt repo (keyring + source list + &#96;apt install terraform&#96;).\n  - OpenTofu: official install script &#96;get.opentofu.org/install-opentofu.sh --install-method deb&#96; (adds repo + installs &#96;tofu&#96;).\n- Linux noRoot (&#96;[sudo]&#96; tag skipped):\n  - Terraform \u0026 OpenTofu: download architecture-matched zip from GitHub releases → extract single binary to &#96;~/.local/bin/&#96; (same pattern as other &#96;~/.local/bin&#96; installs in the networking role).\n  - Azure CLI: &#96;uv tool install azure-cli&#96; (consistent with existing &#96;python_uv_tools&#96; role). Gated behind &#96;uv&#96; being present; warn-and-skip otherwise.\n- Architecture guard: install only on &#96;x86_64&#96;/&#96;aarch64&#96; (wrap in a &#96;when:&#96; check + &#96;rescue&#96; block, matching the networking role's robustness pattern).\n\n## Files to create\n\n- &#96;dot_ansible/roles/iac_tools/tasks/main.yml&#96; — install tasks (macOS homebrew block, Linux sudo apt block, Linux noRoot user-level block). Follow the &#96;rescue:&#96; + &#96;failed_when: false&#96; pattern from [dot_ansible/roles/networking_tools/tasks/main.yml](dot_ansible/roles/networking_tools/tasks/main.yml).\n- &#96;dot_ansible/roles/iac_tools/defaults/main.yml&#96; 根據診斷，結論是：
```

**實際狀況**：3 個工具目前其實都已經裝好了（`az`、`terraform`、`tofu` 都在 `/opt/homebrew/bin/`）。OpenTofu 的 bottle 在 ansible task fail 後仍然繼續下載完成（brew 有自己的內部恢復）。

**根因**：`curl: (18) Transferred a partial file` 是 `ghcr.io`（Homebrew bottle CDN）連線中斷的錯誤，不是 timeout。你的網路到 ghcr.io 頻寬很差（Azure CLI 下載耗時 15 分鐘就是證明），容易 TCP reset。而 `community.general.homebrew` module 沒有內建 retry，任何一次 curl 中斷就會讓整個 ansible task fail。

**修復方向**：幫 macOS 的 3 個 brew install 任務加上 `retries` + `rescue`，讓暫時性網路錯誤自動重試，且單一工具失敗不中斷其他工具。順便在 docs 加上 `HOMEBREW_BOTTLE_DOMAIN` 鏡像設定（給 GFW 用戶）。

一切完成。接下來你可以直接再跑一次 `chezmoi apply` 確認 — 因為三個工具都已經裝好了，homebrew 是 idempotent 的，應該瞬間全部 `ok`。

## 診斷總結

**現狀確認**
```
/opt/homebrew/bin/tofu
/opt/homebrew/bin/terraform
/opt/homebrew/bin/az
```
三個工具其實都已裝好。OpenTofu 的 bottle 在 ansible task 回傳 fail 後仍然繼續完成下載，只是 ansible 已經記為失敗才導致 `chezmoi apply` 整體 exit 2。

**根因**
- `curl: (18) Transferred a partial file` 是 `ghcr.io`（Homebrew bottle CDN）連線中途被切斷，不是 ansible timeout
- 你 Azure CLI 花 14m52s、Terraform 花 17m34s 就是證據 — 單次下載頻寬極度不穩（很可能 GFW 或 ISP 對 ghcr.io 限速 / 偶爾 TCP reset）
- `community.general.homebrew` module 沒有內建 retry，單次 curl 中斷就整個 task fail

**修復內容**

已修改 [`dot_ansible/roles/iac_tools/tasks/main.yml`](dot_ansible/roles/iac_tools/tasks/main.yml)：
- 3 個 macOS brew 安裝任務全部包進 `block:` + `rescue:`
- 加上 `register:` + `until: ... is succeeded` + `retries: 3` + `delay: 20`
- 任一工具失敗只會印 warning，不會中斷其他工具安裝（與 Linux 端的 rescue pattern 一致）
- 開頭加了註解說明為何這樣做

已更新 [`docs/tools/infrastructure-as-code.md`](docs/tools/infrastructure-as-code.md)，新增「Troubleshooting」章節：
- GFW 用戶的 `HOMEBREW_BOTTLE_DOMAIN` 清華鏡像設定
- 手動 `brew install` 重試（brew 會從 partial file 繼續下載，不會白費前面的 bytes）
- 從 GitHub releases 直接下 Terraform / OpenTofu 靜態 binary 的備援方案

**給你的立即建議**

如果你在中國大陸或網路不穩，把這幾行加到 `~/.zshenv` 之後 brew 速度會有明顯改善：
```bash
export HOMEBREW_API_DOMAIN="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/homebrew-bottles/api"
export HOMEBREW_BOTTLE_DOMAIN="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/homebrew-bottles"
```

語法檢查通過（`ansible-playbook --syntax-check` ✓）。

答案是 **可以，而且這是推薦做法**。看你現有的 pattern — `useChineseMirror` 已經驅動了 cargo / npm / bunfig / uv / docker 五個工具的 mirror config，Homebrew 是唯一缺的一塊。加上後完整性就對了。

## 推薦做法：三層覆蓋

Homebrew 讀的是**環境變數**（不像 cargo 讀 config file），所以要在三個地方 export，才能覆蓋所有 brew 被呼叫的場景：

| 場景 | 需要的檔案 | 原因 |
|---|---|---|
| 互動式 shell (`brew install ...`) | `dot_config/zsh/00_exports.zsh.tmpl` | `.zshrc` 載入後 env 就有了 |
| `chezmoi apply` 呼叫 ansible (含首次安裝) | `run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl` | ansible 的 homebrew module 用 subprocess 跑 brew，需要從 parent script 繼承 env |
| 第一次 fresh install 時裝 Homebrew 本身 | `run_once_before_00_bootstrap.sh.tmpl` | 安裝 Homebrew 也是從 GitHub 拉 formula index，這階段 `.zshrc` 還沒 source |

只加第一個（zsh exports）其實也能覆蓋 80% 場景（你只要從 zsh 跑 `chezmoi apply` 就有），但首次 bootstrap 跟確保性依然建議三個都加。

四個要 export 的變數（來自 [TUNA Homebrew 鏡像指南](https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/help/homebrew/)）：

```bash
export HOMEBREW_API_DOMAIN="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/homebrew-bottles/api"
export HOMEBREW_BOTTLE_DOMAIN="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/homebrew-bottles"
export HOMEBREW_BREW_GIT_REMOTE="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/git/homebrew/brew.git"
export HOMEBREW_CORE_GIT_REMOTE="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/git/homebrew/homebrew-core.git"
```

```
# 00_exports.zsh - Environment variables
# Profile: macos (OS: darwin, arch: arm64)

# Editor
# if [[ -n $SSH_CONNECTION ]]; then
#     export EDITOR='vim'
# else
#     export EDITOR='nvim'
# fi
# Let's always use nvim (but sometimes, when the latency is high,
# some animation might be slow)
export EDITOR='nvim'
export VISUAL="$EDITOR"

# Language
export LANG="en_US.UTF-8"
export LC_ALL="en_US.UTF-8"

# PATH additions
# ~/bin for custom scripts, ~/.local/bin for auto-installed tools (uv, npm, cargo)
export PATH="$HOME/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

# Snap binaries (Linux only)
# =============================================================================
# Homebrew Setup
# =============================================================================
# macOS: Initialize Homebrew (Apple Silicon or Intel)
if [[ -f /opt/homebrew/bin/brew ]]; then
    eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"
elif [[ -f /usr/local/bin/brew ]]; then
    eval "$(/usr/local/bin/brew shellenv)"
fi
# Set default Brewfile location (XDG-compliant)
export HOMEBREW_BUNDLE_FILE="$HOME/.config/homebrew/Brewfile"

# Homebrew TUNA (Tsinghua) mirror for GFW users.
# Covers bottles (ghcr.io default → partial-transfer errors) and brew.git/core.
# Managed by chezmoi; disable by answering 'n' to useChineseMirror at init.
# Ref: https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/help/homebrew/
export HOMEBREW_API_DOMAIN="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/homebrew-bottles/api"
export HOMEBREW_BOTTLE_DOMAIN="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/homebrew-bottles"
export HOMEBREW_BREW_GIT_REMOTE="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/git/homebrew/brew.git"
export HOMEBREW_CORE_GIT_REMOTE="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/git/homebrew/homebrew-core.git"
# --- Suggested exports (uncomment to enable) ---
# History configuration (oh-my-zsh handles this, but can customize)
# export HISTSIZE=10000
# export SAVEHIST=10000
# export HISTFILE="$XDG_DATA_HOME/zsh/history"
```

```bash
TMP=$(mktemp); cat > "$TMP" <<'EOF'
{{ if .useChineseMirror -}}
MIRROR_ON
{{ else -}}
MIRROR_OFF
{{ end -}}
EOF
echo '--- with useChineseMirror=true (default from config) ---'; chezmoi execute-template < "$TMP"
echo '--- same pattern but forcing data override via --config flag test ---'
chezmoi execute-template '{{ . | toJson }}' 2>&1 | python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); print("useChineseMirror in data:", d.get("useChineseMirror"))'
rm "$TMP"
```

## Summary

`useChineseMirror=true` (your current setting) now automatically configures Homebrew's TUNA mirror in three places:

**1. `dot_config/zsh/00_exports.zsh.tmpl`** — interactive shells
```50:61:dot_config/zsh/00_exports.zsh.tmpl
{{ if .useChineseMirror -}}
# Homebrew TUNA (Tsinghua) mirror for GFW users.
# Covers bottles (ghcr.io default → partial-transfer errors) and brew.git/core.
# Managed by chezmoi; disable by answering 'n' to useChineseMirror at init.
# Ref: https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/help/homebrew/
export HOMEBREW_API_DOMAIN="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/homebrew-bottles/api"
export HOMEBREW_BOTTLE_DOMAIN="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/homebrew-bottles"
export HOMEBREW_BREW_GIT_REMOTE="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/git/homebrew/brew.git"
export HOMEBREW_CORE_GIT_REMOTE="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/git/homebrew/homebrew-core.git"
{{ end -}}
```

**2. `run_once_before_00_bootstrap.sh.tmpl`** — first-run `brew install` itself (fresh machine case, before `.zshrc` exists)

**3. `run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl`** — so `community.general.homebrew` in the `iac_tools` / `homebrew` roles inherits these in its subprocess

Plus docs:

- `README.md` — new entry under "Managed config files" pointing at the Homebrew mirror block
- `docs/tools/infrastructure-as-code.md` — rewrote troubleshooting step 2 to explain the automatic behavior + fallback manual command

## Why three places instead of just one

| Scenario | zsh only | all three |
|---|---|---|
| Daily `brew install foo` in terminal | ✓ | ✓ |
| `chezmoi apply` invoked from existing zsh session | ✓ (env inherits) | ✓ |
| Fresh install: `chezmoi init --apply` from bash, no `.zshrc` yet | ✗ | ✓ |
| `chezmoi apply` run from cron / CI / bash | ✗ | ✓ |

Since the bootstrap and ansible runner are templated bash scripts, they don't read `.zshrc` — they need their own `export` block. This is the same principle as why the existing `eval "$(brew shellenv)"` is duplicated in `00_exports.zsh.tmpl`, `run_once_before_00_bootstrap.sh.tmpl`, and `run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl` — each bash context is independent.

## To activate

Just run `chezmoi apply` — no re-init needed since you already have `useChineseMirror = true`:

```bash
chezmoi diff       # preview: should show 4 new exports in 00_exports.zsh + two scripts
chezmoi apply
source ~/.zshrc    # or open a new shell
echo $HOMEBREW_BOTTLE_DOMAIN  # → https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/homebrew-bottles
```

Then `brew update` once to resync formulae from TUNA, and future `brew install azure-cli / terraform / opentofu` should no longer hit the `curl: (18)` partial-transfer errors.

Reference: [TUNA Homebrew 鏡像指南](https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/help/homebrew/)

_**Agent (claude-opus-4-7)**_

做了完整 audit，我整理了 repo 裡所有涉及套件下載的工具，對照目前的覆蓋狀態：

## 目前已覆蓋（10 個）

| 生態 | 管理檔案 | 鏡像來源 |
|---|---|---|
| PyPI (uv) | `dot_config/uv/uv.toml.tmpl` | Aliyun / TUNA / USTC multi-index |
| npm | `dot_npmrc.tmpl` | npmmirror |
| Bun | `dot_config/dot_bunfig.toml.tmpl` | npmmirror |
| crates.io | `dot_cargo/config.toml.tmpl` | [TUNA sparse index](https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/help/crates.io-index/) |
| Docker Hub | `dot_config/docker/modify_daemon.json.tmpl` (Linux rootless) | DaoCloud / USTC / NJU / ISCAS / Baidu / azk8s |
| Homebrew (bottles + brew.git + core.git) | `00_exports.zsh.tmpl` + 2 scripts *(剛加)* | [TUNA](https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/help/homebrew/) |
| Ubuntu apt | `Dockerfile` *(Docker only，真機沒覆蓋)* | Huawei Cloud |
| Chinese GUI apps | `Brewfile.darwin.tmpl` | baidunetdisk |

## 缺口 + 建議（按 ROI 排序）

### 🟢 高 ROI — repo 已經在用、GFW 下明顯變慢、加鏡像零風險

**1. RubyGems** — `ruby_gem_tools` role 目前用 `gem install` 直連 rubygems.org
- 做法：新增 `dot_gemrc.tmpl`（template 出 `~/.gemrc`）+ 在 role 裡 `gem sources --clear-all && gem sources --add <mirror>`
- TUNA URL: https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/help/rubygems/
- 鏡像：`https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/rubygems/`

**2. Rustup distribution** — `mise install rust@latest`（以及首次 `rustup-init`）會抓 `https://static.rust-lang.org/`，是 GFW 下的經典痛點
- 做法：在 `00_exports.zsh.tmpl` + `run_once_before_00_bootstrap.sh.tmpl` 加兩個 env var
  - `RUSTUP_DIST_SERVER=https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/rustup`
  - `RUSTUP_UPDATE_ROOT=https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/rustup/rustup`
- TUNA URL: https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/help/rustup/

**3. mise runtime prebuilt archives** — mise 裝 Node/Python 時抓 `https://nodejs.org/dist` / `https://www.python.org/ftp/python`
- 做法：zsh exports 加
  - `MISE_NODE_MIRROR_URL=https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/nodejs-release/`
  - `MISE_PYTHON_DEFAULT_PACKAGES_FILE` 不動，但可考慮 `PYTHON_BUILD_MIRROR_URL=https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/python/`
- 這個影響 `mise install node@20` / `mise install python@3.12` 的下載速度

### 🟡 中 ROI — 非 repo 核心但用戶日常會碰到

**4. `.condarc` for conda/mamba** — `04_conda_mamba.zsh` lazy-load conda，但沒 template `.condarc`。若用戶裝了 miniforge / miniconda，預設 channel 是 GFW-blocked 的 `repo.anaconda.com`
- ⚠️ 風險：`.condarc` 可能已被用戶手動編輯過；應該用 modify_ script 而不是覆蓋式 template
- TUNA URL: https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/help/anaconda/

**5. Go proxy** — `GOPROXY=https://goproxy.cn,direct` (Qiniu，不是 TUNA，但是 Go 社群事實標準)
- 零成本的 env var，就算沒裝 Go 也不會壞事

### 🔴 低 ROI / 有副作用 — 不建議自動化

- **系統 apt sources (真機 Linux)**：Docker 有做，但改真機 `/etc/apt/sources.list.d/` 太侵入，且多數用戶裝 OS 時已自己配好 —— 留給手動 / ansible playbook 的獨立選項
- **pip 系統級** (`~/.config/pip/pip.conf`)：`uv.toml` 已覆蓋主要路徑，system pip 只在 `security_tools` 做 fallback 且很少觸發
- **GitHub releases / raw.githubusercontent.com rewrite**：TUNA 有 `github-release` 鏡像但映射不完整；git `insteadOf` 改寫太全局化，容易破壞 gh CLI 和私有 repo
- **oh-my-zsh / tmux TPM / pre-commit hooks**：都 clone 自 github.com，改寫 git remote 風險高

---

## 建議的下一步

想聽你的優先順序再動手，或一次全包？我的建議是：

**一次做掉 1 + 2 + 3**（RubyGems + Rustup + mise runtimes），因為：
- 三個都跟著 `useChineseMirror` gate，跟剛做的 Homebrew pattern 完全一致
- 都是純 env var / 純 dotfile，沒有 modify script 或侵入式改動
- 都能直接看到 `chezmoi apply` 後下次 `gem install` / `mise install rust` / `mise install node` 變快

**4 (conda) 和 5 (goproxy) 看你用不用頻繁**，用得多就加，反之跳過。

你想怎麼取捨？

```
# ~/.condarc - Conda/Mamba configuration
# Managed by chezmoi ONLY when useChineseMirror=true (see .chezmoiignore.tmpl).
# If useChineseMirror=false, this file is NOT managed and any existing
# ~/.condarc stays untouched.
#
# TUNA anaconda mirror — covers defaults (main/r/msys2) and common cloud
# channels (conda-forge, bioconda, pytorch, nvidia, etc.). Rewrites channel
# URLs on the client side so &#96;conda install&#96; and &#96;mamba install&#96; hit the
# mirror instead of the blocked repo.anaconda.com.
#
# Ref: https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/help/anaconda/
#
# Note: cached package metadata under ~/.conda/ may need a one-time
# refresh after switching mirrors:
#     conda clean -i

channels:
  - defaults

show_channel_urls: true
---
# ~/.gemrc - Ruby Gems configuration
# Managed by chezmoi
# RubyGems TUNA (Tsinghua) mirror for GFW users.
# Affects &#96;gem install&#96; in the ruby_gem_tools ansible role and any manual
# &#96;gem install&#96;. Read before the default rubygems.org source.
# Ref: https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/help/rubygems/
:sources:
  - https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/rubygems/

# Common options (applied regardless of mirror)
gem: --no-document
:verbose: true
:update_sources: true
:backtrace: false
:bulk_threshold: 1000
---

# Zsh secrets file (API keys, tokens, proxy - never track)
.config/zsh/secrets.zsh

# Zsh adhoc file (personal experiments - never track)
.zshrc.adhoc

# Python bytecode caches
**/__pycache__

# .local directory (dynamically managed by package managers)
.local/

# GFW-only managed files — only manage when useChineseMirror=true,
# otherwise leave any existing user file untouched.

```

```
# Linux Package Sources: apt vs Linuxbrew vs snap vs GitHub binaries

This repo mixes several package sources on Linux. This document explains what each is good at, the trade-offs, and the policy the ansible roles follow.

These package managers are **complementary, not substitutes**. Picking the right source for a tool is what keeps this dotfiles setup fast, portable, and safe across &#96;ubuntu_desktop&#96;, &#96;ubuntu_server&#96;, and &#96;noRoot&#96; profiles.

## Side-by-side comparison

| Dimension | apt | snap | Linuxbrew | GitHub binary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Version freshness | Poor (LTS freeze) | Medium–Good | **Good** (near-upstream) | Good |
| Sudo required | Yes | Yes (+ snapd daemon, needs systemd) | Yes at install (chown &#96;/home/linuxbrew&#96;) | **No** |
| Cross-platform with macOS | Linux-only | Linux-only | **Same formula names as macOS Homebrew** | If upstream ships binaries |
| Sandboxing | None | **AppArmor + strict interfaces** | None | None |
| Startup / resource cost | Lowest | High (squashfs mount + bundled libs per snap) | Medium (bottles ship own lib paths) | Lowest |
| System services / daemons | **Best** | OK but constrained by confinement | Poor (&#96;brew services&#96; on Linux is experimental) | Manual |
| Catalog breadth | Largest | Medium (GUI-heavy) | Strong for CLI / dev tools | One tool per source |
| Upgrade control | Ships with distro upgrades | Auto-refresh (hard to disable cleanly) | Explicit &#96;brew upgrade&#96; (rolling) | Manual / ansible-driven |
| Disk footprint | Small (shared libs) | Large (redundant libs, retains prev. revisions) | Medium (~/.linuxbrew 10–15 GB common) | Small |
| Breakage risk | Low (distro maintainers vetted) | Medium (silent refresh can change behaviour) | Low (rolling, explicit) | Low |
| Works in &#96;noRoot&#96; mode | ❌ | ❌ (snapd needs sudo + systemd) | ⚠️ Unsupported &#96;~/homebrew&#96; mode exists but loses bottles → needs &#96;libevent-dev&#96; etc. → circles back to sudo | ✅ |

## Pick-by-tool-type

| Tool type | Preferred source | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Modern CLI dev tools (tmux, neovim, ripgrep, fd, zoxide, starship, eza, yazi, sesh, television) | **Linuxbrew** if sudo available; **GitHub binary** in &#96;noRoot&#96; | Freshest versions, shared formula names with macOS &#96;Brewfile.darwin&#96;, no confinement friction |
| System daemons / kernel or systemd-adjacent tools (Docker Engine, OpenSSH server, NetworkManager, CUDA, nvidia drivers) | **apt** | snap sandbox fights with host-integrated daemons; brew has no story for system services on Linux |
| Sandboxed or closed-source GUI (Slack, some IDEs, Bitwarden Desktop) | **snap** / flatpak / vendor &#96;.deb&#96; | brew-linux has no cask; apt versions lag; snap's automatic updates + confinement are a fit |
| Language runtimes (Node, Python, Ruby, Rust) | **mise** (already used) | Multi-version, project-aware, user-level — beats every OS package manager for this job |

```

</tool-use>

All done. Lint warnings are markdown table-style consistency nits (same pattern used in every existing doc table — e.g., `linux-package-sources.md`), not errors.

## Summary — mirror audit + implementation

### Net new ecosystems covered (5)

| # | Ecosystem | Mechanism | Files |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **RubyGems** | `~/.gemrc` with TUNA `:sources:` | `dot_gemrc.tmpl` + `.chezmoiignore.tmpl` gate |
| 2 | **Rustup dist + self-update** | `RUSTUP_DIST_SERVER` / `RUSTUP_UPDATE_ROOT` env | `00_exports.zsh.tmpl` + bootstrap + runner |
| 3 | **mise Node.js prebuilt** | `MISE_NODE_MIRROR_URL` / `NODE_BUILD_MIRROR_URL` env | same 3 files |
| 4 | **Go modules** | `GOPROXY=https://goproxy.cn,direct` + `GOSUMDB=sum.golang.google.cn` | `00_exports.zsh.tmpl` (interactive only; Go not in ansible) |
| 5 | **Anaconda / Mamba** | `~/.condarc` with TUNA channels | `dot_condarc.tmpl` + `.chezmoiignore.tmpl` gate |

### Files changed (9)

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `dot_gemrc.tmpl` | **new** — gated on `useChineseMirror` via chezmoiignore |
| `dot_condarc.tmpl` | **new** — preserves your `channels: [conda-forge]` + `auto_activate_base: true`, adds TUNA overlay |
| `docs/tools/mirrors.md` | **new** — consolidated mirror reference + coverage matrix + troubleshooting |
| `.chezmoiignore` → `.chezmoiignore.tmpl` | renamed; gates `.condarc` / `.gemrc` when `useChineseMirror=false` |
| `dot_config/zsh/00_exports.zsh.tmpl` | Homebrew + Rustup + mise + GOPROXY env vars |
| `run_once_before_00_bootstrap.sh.tmpl` | Homebrew + Rustup + mise (for fresh-install path) |
| `run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl` | Homebrew + Rustup + mise (for ansible subprocess) |
| `README.md` | updated 3 existing entries, added `.gemrc` + `.condarc`, linked `docs/tools/mirrors.md` |
| `docs/tools/infrastructure-as-code.md` | troubleshooting section now cross-links `mirrors.md` |

### Safety guarantees

- `.condarc` preserves your existing `channels: [conda-forge]` and `auto_activate_base: true` — verified via `chezmoi diff`
- `.gemrc` and `.condarc` are **only managed when `useChineseMirror=true`** — flip the flag off and chezmoi leaves your custom files alone
- All three env-var export locations mirror each other, so no scenario (interactive / first-run / ansible) misses the mirror

### To activate

```bash
chezmoi apply      # applies all 5 mirror ecosystems + the 3-layer env-var bundle
source ~/.zshrc    # or open new shell

echo $RUSTUP_DIST_SERVER           # → https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/rustup
echo $GOPROXY                      # → https://goproxy.cn,direct
echo $MISE_NODE_MIRROR_URL         # → https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/nodejs-release/
cat ~/.gemrc | head -5             # → :sources: - https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/rubygems/
conda clean -i                     # one-time: refresh conda channel cache
```

Full coverage map + "how to add a new mirror" recipe lives at [`docs/tools/mirrors.md`](docs/tools/mirrors.md). References: [TUNA](https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/), [goproxy.cn](https://goproxy.cn/), [npmmirror](https://npmmirror.com/).
